assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent cutout of the BODY of a red Christmas keepsake box for a moving illustrated browser story.
Input images: Image 1 (forest) and Image 2 (Santa globe) are STYLE/LIGHTING references only, do not copy scenery or characters.
Create ONE beautifully hand-painted squat rectangular keepsake chest BODY, open at the top, WITHOUT ANY LID. Genuine transparent background.
Medium: exquisite children's book gouache on fibrous paper, visible soft layered brush strokes, warm gold highlights and deep blue reflected shadow, matching the reference illustrations. NOT plastic, not flat vector, not photorealistic.
Design: deep carmine red painted wood wrapped in velvety textured paper, very fine antique gold star details and delicate corner filigree. The front has a large quiet plain red field for readable clues later; a tiny oval brass lock plate near the lower center, blank with no numbers. No bow tying the box shut. Interior is completely EMPTY, dark red velvet with a little cream-gold warm reflected light, no glow beams.
View: almost straight-on, camera elevated just enough to see the EMPTY top cavity. Top opening is a simple symmetrical trapezoid: horizontal back rim narrower than horizontal front rim. Front wall broad and almost rectangular; only thin symmetrical side walls. Width to total visible height approx 1.4:1. The back rim must be horizontal and unbroken, able to attach a separate moving lid. Lower edge level, no dramatic perspective.
Composition: centered single object, comfortably inside all edges with generous transparent margin, full body and opening visible. Do not include a lid anywhere, gift contents, papers, animals, Santa, text, numerals, floor, snow, shadow outside the object, forest, UI, watermark, book, or other props.
The craftsmanship should be worthy of sitting beside the adorable Santa in the reference, while remaining a simple box rather than a fantastical palace.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE isolated lid surface sprite for the red Christmas keepsake chest in Image 1.
Image 1 is the exact design/material reference for matching the BODY; Image 2 forest is a style reference.
Generate ONLY the matching detached rectangular LID PANEL. View the panel square-on as a flat painted rectangle, not in perspective and not attached to a box. It will be perspective-projected onto the body's hinge by browser code.
Same deep carmine velvety painted wood/paper, exquisite gouache/fibrous paper strokes, fine antique gold border with modest matching holly/star corner filigree. Quiet red center with a small graceful gold star motif. Lid has a thin continuous gold rim and very subtle thickness along the perimeter; straight horizontal top/bottom, straight vertical left/right, modestly softened corners. Width:height about 2.2:1. Do not depict an opening, box wall, body, hinges protruding outside, bevel in perspective or multiple pieces.
Fully visible panel centered with transparent margin on all sides, genuine transparent background. No shadow outside object, floor, forest, snow, ribbons tying it shut, labels, text, digits, animal, papers or extra props. One rectangle that matches the red box exactly, hand-painted rather than a vector button.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: tiny hand-painted tanuki clue illustration printed on parchment inside a red-box investigation UI.
Input images: forest and Santa globe are style references only.
One adorable Japanese tanuki (raccoon dog), rounded face, dark mask around two shiny eyes, small rounded ears, fluffy brown grey fur, short paws and a bushy plain tail (NOT raccoon stripes), sitting looking forward, with a curious gentle expression.
Gouache on fibrous storybook paper, tactile soft layered brush strokes, warm brown and cream with quiet gold light, same charming handmade medium as the supplied Santa. A modest readable animal sketch, not a mascot with costume.
ONE animal centered full body isolated on genuine transparent background with generous margin. No paper rectangle, background, scene, floor shadow, text, letters, numbers, Christmas props or extra animals. Keep a strong readable silhouette at 70 pixels tall.

runtime: Only local bundled images are used. Alpha padding is trimmed in memory; original files and generated sources are preserved.
